summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temporary directory, extracts it, sets it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB script math_init.js. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated using hex-identifier string dictionaries that hide Alpine/musl detection and a Windows PowerShell Expand-Archive fallback for unzip. math_init.js uses shuffled string-array obfuscation and hex-mangled identifiers throughout, blocking static inspection of its final behavior. The package's advertised purpose is a small PostCSS configuration; there is no legitimate need for a PostCSS config package to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to execute a large obfuscated blob. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine via a non-Node runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
